::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## About the Python tabs
Most code blocks on this page have an **R** and a **Python** tab, and picking one
switches the whole page. Both run when the site is built, and each tab shows its own
output. The Python tab is the scikit-learn equivalent of the R; the figures come from
R throughout, and a few steps with no scikit-learn counterpart have no Python tab,
which is itself worth noticing.

Expect the **numbers to differ slightly** where randomness is involved: R and Python
draw their random splits from different generators, so the split is not the same one.
The conclusions are.
:::
